sites.note: Colossus. MLGW is a municipal utility buying from TVA, so the grid footprint is TVA. MATERIAL CAVEAT: xAI also runs dozens of mobile gas turbines on site, reported around 495 MW. On-site generation does not appear in EIA-930 at all, so our grid figure describes only the portion drawn from TVA and understates this site's fossil use.

confidence=medium. State of Mississippi release confirms xAI's retrofitted Southaven building in DeSoto County plus an xAI-acquired power plant site. Entergy is the provider for Southaven (Northcentral Electric serves only the eastern county); that utility link is inferred from county economic-development material. Same caveat as Memphis: xAI runs its own gas turbines, which EIA-930 does not see.

talk_score_method: magnitude x specificity x scope_breadth, 0-1. How big the number is, how precisely it is stated, and how little it is hedged. Narrowing qualifiers (annual, market-based, certificates, owned-and-operated) reduce scope_breadth.
walk_score_method: mean physical carbon-free share across mapped sites, calendar 2025, all hours, grid-only, unweighted by site size.
